items.title: Milt Hinton interviewed by Joe Williams, Majesty of the Seas, May 31, 1995
items.q: That reminds me of that tale that Pete told last night

ctx.x: That reminds me of that tale that Pete told last night, you know every time he’d go through customs going to Canada, they would look at his Tasty Cakes, examine his Tasty Cakes, break them open, see if there’s anything inside them. And still he gets so he says when he goes to Canada, he gets his Tasty Cakes you know here, and he‘s got the pile of dope here, and when they start to go in the Tasty Cakes, he goes, “No here’s what you’re looking for, it’s over here.” Well I want to thank you, man, we could talk for…
So beautiful to be here, Joe.
